title: Background Remover
description: Turn any image with a solid, single-color background into a clean transparent PNG — batch, with edge halo removal.

title: Emote Puppet
description: Hand-animate a single static emote — bend and stretch it with a pin & pull mesh, drop keyframes on a timeline and export a smooth, perfectly seamless looping GIF. Save your work as a .puppet project to continue or revise it anytime. Rendered with high-quality libvips (sharp)

title: Live Emote
description: Turn a single static emote into an animated GIF — pick a motion preset (breathing, bounce, heartbeat, spin and more), tune it in a real-time preview and export a perfect seamless loop. No frames to draw, rendered with high-quality libvips (sharp)

title: GIF Resizer
description: Resize animated GIFs to any custom size while keeping every frame, timing and loop intact — powered by high-quality libvips scaling

title: Animate Emote Frames
description: Build animated emotes from PNG frames — set frame rate, pick platform (Twitch / YouTube / Discord) and export GIFs in all standard sizes as a single ZIP

title: Image Resizer
description: Resize one or more images to specified dimensions and save the output files to disk

title: Delivery Sheet
description: Generate a professional PNG delivery sheet showing all emotes and badges at every standard size — ready to send to clients for approval
